title: Signal: Go dependency carrying the +incompatible marker
scope: A go.mod file that declares a `+incompatible` version, which declares a major version without a matching module path.
limitations: It matches a `+incompatible` version, which declares a major version without a matching module path in the parsed go.mod; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
fpNotes: A go.mod that mentions a `+incompatible` version, which declares a major version without a matching module path in a comment, a documentation example or a template placeholder is not reported; the rule reads the parsed value that the installer acts on.
